titulo: Do violent video games make you violent? What the American Psychological Association said in 2020
destinatario: a gamer sends it to the parent (or uncle) who says GTA is frying their brain, to show what psychologists actually concluded
regla_guardable: APA 2020: insufficient scientific evidence that violent video games cause violent behavior; small link with mild aggression (yelling, pushing)

frases.texto: That violent games turn you violent.
The science is shakier than that.
In twenty twenty, the American Psychological Association reviewed the evidence.
It concluded there's insufficient scientific evidence to say violent video games cause violent behavior.
Heads up: it did find a small link with mild aggression, like yelling or pushing.
And it said that's hard to extend to serious violence.
Yelling at your screen when you lose is one thing. Real violence is another.
